title: Application to MVV/Residence Permit Process Steps for Netherlands
notice: 1 EUR ≈ 119 BDT (approximate). Unlike Germany, there is no fixed blocked account in the Netherlands. Instead, IND requires proof of sufficient funds (~11,000–14,000 EUR) in your bank account. Your university sponsors your residence permit (VVR) through IND — this is handled by the university's International Office.

processSteps.label: University Application : via Studielink.nl (Dutch programs) or university portal (English programs)
bullets: Most English Master's programs: apply directly on university website
Common deadlines: 1 February (main) or 1 April (second round) for September intake
Documents: CV, Motivation Letter, 2 Reference Letters, IELTS/TOEFL, transcripts, Passport copy

processSteps.label: Admission Letter & Scholarship Application
bullets: Confirm enrollment after receiving conditional/unconditional offer
Apply for Holland Scholarship, Orange Tulip Scholarship, or university-specific scholarships
Deadline for most scholarships: February–March (same as admission)

processSteps.label: University Sponsors IND Residence Permit Application
bullets: University's International Office submits your permit application to IND
IND processes it — university notifies you once approved (usually 4–8 weeks)
Prepare financial proof: ~11,000–14,000 EUR in bank account or scholarship confirmation

processSteps.label: MVV (Entry Visa) Application at VFS Global Dhaka
bullets: Book appointment at VFS Global Dhaka after IND approval
MVV fee: 192 EUR (~22,800 BDT)
VFS service fee: ~30 EUR (~3,600 BDT)
Submit: passport, photo, admission letter, financial proof, accommodation confirmation
Processing: 3–6 weeks after VFS appointment

processSteps.label: Arrange Housing & Health Insurance Before Departure
bullets: Apply for university dorm as early as possible — housing is highly competitive
Arrange travel insurance for the flight and first weeks
Health insurance (Zorgverzekering) must be arranged within 4 months of arrival: ~120–160 EUR/month

processSteps.label: Arrive in Netherlands & IND Check-In
bullets: Register at the Gemeente (municipality) to receive your BSN (Citizen Service Number)
Report to IND within 3 days of arrival — university helps coordinate this
Collect Residence Permit (VVR) card from IND

processSteps.label: Residence Permit (VVR) — issued after IND check-in
bullets: VVR is issued for the duration of your studies
Allows part-time work: 16 hours/week during academic year; full-time in summer
Renewable as long as you remain enrolled and meet conditions

costSteps.label: MVV Entry Visa Fee : 192 EUR (~22,800 BDT) — paid at Dutch Embassy via VFS
VFS Global Service Fee : ~30 EUR (~3,600 BDT) — visa submission
Financial Proof in Bank : ~11,000–14,000 EUR (~13–17 lac BDT) — your own living funds
Tuition Fee : 8,000–20,000 EUR/year — varies by university and program
Health Insurance : ~120–160 EUR/month — Dutch Zorgverzekering required within 4 months
BSN Registration : free at Gemeente (City Hall)
